vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2026-0097
vulnerability.description: rand 0.8.5 — unsoundness in log-feature reseed path

statements.impact_statement: The unsoundness requires the rand `log` feature plus a custom logger that calls `thread_rng()` during reseed. Springtale's workspace `Cargo.toml` pins `rand` with `default-features = false`, so the `log` feature is absent from every binary in the workspace. The UB code path is unreachable.
statements.action_statement: Awaiting RustCrypto ecosystem release of stable versions on rand_core 0.9 (ed25519-dalek 3.x, chacha20poly1305 0.11.x). Will upgrade to rand 0.9.3+ at that time. Mitigated by feature exclusion, not accepted risk.
